name: Old Mother Mast
text: Start of Turn: get an Acorn per 5 gold in your Larder. Up to 5.
golden_text: Start of Turn: get two Acorns per 5 gold in your Larder. Up to 10.

source.note: Pass 3; amended tribe gates and provisional paper B/C rates in content/pass3/rates.json.

details: Larder gold is read before this payout. Each copy pays separately. Up to the displayed number per turn; the rate overlay can remove this loop limit.
